resources.string: Watch the four rails meet beneath the seat. The square of air between them keeps this little stool looking light.
The shade settles onto a crosspiece. A little amber light spills from the rim, just enough for a quiet corner of the desk.
A tonearm reaches over the record as its grooves catch the light. A small brass-coloured plate finishes the wooden plinth.
The deck slips between two rails. Set this little bridge between stacks of books and you have a path across your desk.
The books settle in one by one against the end support. Their spines sit at different heights, ready for a browsing finger.
A pen and small odds and ends find their own corners. The raised lip keeps the things that roll away close at hand.
Coloured bars span two wooden rails. Follow the row from long to short and you can almost hear the notes climbing.
The red drawer slides far out at the bottom while the upper drawer peeks forward. Each leaves its handle within reach.
A pot rests on a square platform with room for its leaves to spread. The short legs lift a patch of green off the desk.
The shelves rise from the base, one level at a time. Only when the cubbies are ready do the files and boxes slide home.
